conditions.description: Fresh-process actual shared WASM32, four CPU lanes, Node filesystem adapter for OPFS; startup, table construction and checkpoints included; no text export or Hilbert; progress off except explicit ablation. Default 128 MiB budget, 32 MiB scratch, hashBits=16. Baseline separately built from supplied 0.5.0 with same Clang/flags. Sequential trials, alternating order for main pairs.
